# Staffic MCP

**Hosted MCP server** - Staffic combines time tracking, screenshot monitoring and project management in one platform, so a manager can see how a team spends its hours rather than relying on manual timesheets.

```
Server type: Hosted
Auth: Account sign-in
Endpoint: see vendor docs at staffic.io
Pricing: free forever for teams up to 3; no card required
Category: Operations
Built by: Staffic (staffic.io)
```

## Why This Matters for Operators

Time tracking usually fragments into a timer here, a project board there, and a spreadsheet at payroll. Staffic pulls those into one connected platform, which means an agent can answer operational questions from real activity data instead of a timesheet someone filled in on Friday. Screenshot monitoring adds a proof-of-work layer for teams that bill by the hour, and the free tier up to three seats lets a small team evaluate it without a card.

For operators running agencies or contract teams, the value is payroll accuracy and project costing: knowing what was actually worked, on what, for how long. That is the kind of surface an agent can summarize on demand.

## Evaluate

- Combines time tracking, screenshot monitoring and project management.
- Free forever for teams up to 3, no credit card required.
- The demo needs no signup, so the workflow can be checked before any commitment.

## Limitations

- Screenshot monitoring is a policy decision as much as a tool one; disclose it to teams.
- Connector surface depends on the vendor's published tools; check current docs.
- Billing and payroll integration depth varies by plan.

## FAQ
